sun.1: Your attention tends to land on yourself as a visible presence: your body, your bearing, how you walk into a room. People often read you quickly, and much of your life gets set in motion by what you do first-hand.
sun.2: Money, possessions and what you can count on draw much of your attention. You tend to measure yourself by what you have earned or built, and to feel steadier once there is something solid under you.
sun.3: Daily talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone whose identity gets worked out in conversation, errands and the small exchanges of the street you live on.
sun.4: Home, family and the ground under your feet tend to draw you. A parent, a house or a piece of land can carry more of your sense of self than any public role, and you may think often about how things end.
sun.5: Pleasure, play, romance and making things tend to pull your attention. Children, or the creative work that stands in for them, is read as where you most feel like yourself and most want to be seen.
sun.6: Work and routine draw your attention: the small daily labours, the care of your health, and being useful to others. This is read as a life that finds its shape in what gets done each day, quietly and in order.
sun.7: Other people hold your attention: partners, spouses, close collaborators, and the people who oppose you openly. You tend to learn who you are by what happens across the table from you, including in contracts and agreements.
sun.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what you owe others tend to draw your attention, along with the subject of death. You are read as someone drawn to what is held in common and what must eventually be settled.
sun.9: Long journeys, foreign places, belief and higher learning tend to draw you. This reads as a life oriented by a large idea or a distant horizon, and you are often most yourself when studying, teaching or travelling.
sun.10: Career, reputation and public standing hold your attention strongly, and others tend to see this. You are read as someone whose work is visible, with honour and responsibility attached to what you do.
sun.11: Friends, allies and patrons tend to hold your attention, along with what you hope for. You are read as someone who finds purpose through groups and the people who back you, and who keeps long-range aims in view.
sun.12: Your attention tends to go to what is private and out of sight: solitude, retreat, old sorrows, and the habits that undermine you. It can read as a self that works behind the scenes and is clearer when alone.

moon.1: Your moods and body tend to show on the surface, and people read you through your temperament. Attention goes to how you feel physically, how you respond, and how others see you react.
moon.2: Attention tends to land on money and possessions as sources of security. Your sense of having enough shifts with the month, and what you own or can rely on is tied to how settled you feel.
moon.3: Talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to draw you, and this is the place the Moon traditionally rests easily. You are read as someone at home in daily chatter, messages and the nearby streets.
moon.4: Home, family and the mother or other parent tend to hold your attention. Roots, old houses, land and how a life winds down are read as central, and you may feel your moods most strongly in your own rooms.
moon.5: Your attention tends to go to pleasure, romance, play and children. Feelings are read as something you make and share, and affection or a creative project can steady you more than you expect.
moon.6: Daily routine, health and small tasks tend to draw you, and your mood follows the state of your habits. You are read as someone who cares for others through practical service, and who notices bodily changes early.
moon.7: Partners and close one-to-one bonds tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone who feels through other people, and who takes cues from a spouse, associate or opponent about how things stand.
moon.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what is owed tend to draw your attention, with a feeling for loss and endings. You are read as sensitive to what passes between people, and slow to let go of what was given.
moon.9: Travel, foreign places, belief and study tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone who feels settled when the horizon is wide, and who gathers a sense of home from far-off places and ideas.
moon.10: Your public standing tends to draw your attention, and your reputation is read as changeable, rising and falling with how people feel about you. Work that serves the public or deals with ordinary people suits the pattern.
moon.11: Friends, groups and patrons tend to draw your attention, and your hopes shift with who you spend time with. You are read as someone who gathers people easily and finds comfort in a wider circle.
moon.12: Attention tends to land on what is hidden: solitude, retreat, private sorrow and dreams. You are read as feeling a great deal that you do not show, and as needing time apart to settle.

mercury.1: Your attention tends to go to thinking, speaking and noticing. You are read as quick, curious and expressive, and the first thing others meet is often your voice, your wit or your hands.
mercury.2: Money and possessions tend to draw your thinking: accounts, prices, trade, and which skills you can sell. You are read as someone who counts carefully and earns through talking, writing or dealing.
mercury.3: Writing, talk, siblings, neighbours and short journeys tend to hold your attention. A life full of letters, errands, questions and local news is the usual reading, with plenty of small exchanges each day.
mercury.4: Your thinking tends to circle home, family and the past. Papers, records, family stories and talk with a parent are read as central, and you may do your best reading and writing at home.
mercury.5: Wit, games, flirtation and making things tend to draw your mind. You are read as someone who enjoys clever company, who writes or plays for pleasure, and who talks easily with children.
mercury.6: Work, lists and daily detail tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who solves practical problems, handles paperwork, and watches your health through careful observation.
mercury.7: Your attention tends to land on dialogue: partners, clients, negotiations and contracts. You are read as someone who thinks through conversation, and who deals with open rivals by arguing the case.
mercury.8: Shared money, debts, wills and what is owed tend to draw your thinking. You are read as inclined to ask questions others avoid, and to study what lies beneath accounts, secrets and endings.
mercury.9: Study, travel, foreign languages and big questions tend to hold your attention. You are read as a mind that likes to range, to compare beliefs, and to turn what it learns abroad into writing or teaching.
mercury.10: Your thinking tends to attach to career and reputation. You are read as known for what you say or write, and suited to work in which talk, information or skill with words is visible.
mercury.11: Friends, associates and networks tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who gathers ideas through other people, who writes to patrons and allies, and who plans with them.
mercury.12: Your mind tends to turn inward, toward what is private: hidden knowledge, worry, solitary study and what goes unsaid. You are read as thinking best alone, and as prone to mulling things over at night.

venus.1: Your attention tends to go to how you look and are received. Grace, charm and comfort in your own body are read as marks of the position, and people often meet you first as pleasant.
venus.2: Money, possessions and the things you enjoy owning tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who values beauty and comfort, and who earns or saves through pleasing others or tasteful work.
venus.3: Attention tends to land on gentle talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips. You are read as courteous in daily exchange, with affection for local places and for the people living close by.
venus.4: Home, family and the surroundings you live in tend to draw you. You are read as someone who makes a house pleasant, who values harmony with a parent, and who looks for comfort in later life.
venus.5: Pleasure, romance, art and children tend to draw your attention, and this is where Venus is traditionally most at ease. You are read as someone who enjoys, gives enjoyment, and makes things for delight.
venus.6: Daily work and routine tend to carry Venus's taste for pleasantness into the job: tidy workplaces, colleagues you like, and care given freely. Small comforts are read as important to your health.
venus.7: Partners and marriage tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who seeks agreement, who treats open rivals with courtesy, and who values a bond that is fair to both sides.
venus.8: Attention tends to land on shared money, gifts, inheritance and the intimacy of trust. You are read as someone for whom what other people give, and what you give back, is bound up with closeness.
venus.9: Long journeys, foreign cultures, belief and learning tend to draw your affection. You are read as drawn to beauty far from home, and to teachers, faiths or places that feel generous.
venus.10: Your public standing tends to depend on charm and taste. You are read as someone whose work gains favour, and who may be recognised in fields of beauty, hospitality or diplomacy.
venus.11: Friends, allies and patrons tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone whose good fortune comes through warm company, with affection for groups and hopes shared with the people you like.
venus.12: Attention tends to land on private affection: quiet love, secret attachments and tenderness shown out of sight. You are read as finding comfort in retreat, and as giving more than you let anyone see.

mars.1: Your attention tends to go to action, the body and being direct. You are read as energetic and quick to respond, and others often meet you as forceful before they meet anything else.
mars.2: Money and possessions tend to draw your effort. You are read as someone who works hard for what you have, who spends quickly, and who defends your own resources when they are threatened.
mars.3: Talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to stir your attention. You are read as blunt in daily speech, quick to argue, and energetic about errands and local matters.
mars.4: Home, family and land tend to draw your energy, sometimes through friction with a parent or over property. You are read as someone who works on the house, and who ends things firmly.
mars.5: Pleasure, sport, romance and making things tend to hold your attention, and you pursue them with heat. You are read as competitive in play, ardent in love and energetic with children.
mars.6: Work and daily routine tend to draw your effort, and this is a place where Mars is traditionally at home. You are read as hardworking and practical, good with tools and demanding tasks, and prone to overwork or minor injury.
mars.7: Partners and open rivals tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who meets others head on, who argues over contracts, and who feels most alive when a relationship has some friction.
mars.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what is owed tend to draw your attention, sometimes with conflict. You are read as someone who deals directly with danger, loss and the settling of accounts.
mars.9: Long journeys, belief and higher learning tend to draw your drive. You are read as someone who argues for convictions, who is restless abroad, and who treats study as a contest.
mars.10: Career and public standing tend to draw your ambition. You are read as a striver whose work is visible, who takes command, and who may meet opposition from those above.
mars.11: Friends, allies and patrons tend to hold your attention. You are read as someone who works with groups toward a goal, who fights for causes, and who sometimes quarrels with allies.
mars.12: Your attention tends to land on hidden effort: anger kept private, struggles unseen, and opposition out of sight. You are read as needing a safe outlet for drive, and as working best in seclusion.

jupiter.1: Your attention tends to go to growth and generosity of presence. You are read as someone who comes across as open, hopeful and sizeable, with an appetite for life that others notice.
jupiter.2: Money and possessions tend to draw your attention with a leaning toward abundance. You are read as someone who earns by being generous or wise, and who tends to feel that enough can be found.
jupiter.3: Talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to hold your attention. You are read as generous in conversation, interested in teaching and sharing news, and friendly with those who live nearby.
jupiter.4: Home, family and land tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone who values a roomy house, a generous parent, and a settled late life, and who likes to gather family around.
jupiter.5: Pleasure, romance, creative work and children tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone with an expansive taste for enjoyment, and for the company of children and play.
jupiter.6: Daily work, health and service tend to hold your attention. You are read as helpful, well regarded among colleagues, and inclined to take on more than a single day allows.
jupiter.7: Partners and agreements tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone who seeks fairness, who gains through marriage or alliance, and who meets open rivals with a large view.
jupiter.8: Shared resources, inheritance and debts tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone who trusts what others hold in common, who may receive from them, and who faces endings with some breadth.
jupiter.9: Long journeys, foreign places, belief and learning tend to hold your attention, and Jupiter has room to roam here. You are read as a teacher or traveller drawn to large ideas.
jupiter.10: Career and public standing tend to draw your attention. You are read as someone whose reputation grows with generosity, whose work carries honour, and who is looked to for judgment.
jupiter.11: Friends, allies and patrons tend to hold your attention, and this is where Jupiter is traditionally most at ease. You are read as someone supported by good company, and drawn to hopes shared with many people.
jupiter.12: Your attention tends to land on private generosity, retreat, charity and faith in hard times. You are read as finding help from unseen sources, and meaning in solitude or in service to people who are confined.

saturn.1: Your attention tends to go to restraint and self-discipline. You are read as reserved, serious or slow to warm, with a body and manner that others see as steady and sometimes guarded.
saturn.2: Money and possessions tend to draw careful attention. You are read as someone who earns slowly, saves, and distrusts easy gain, and who feels secure only on what has been proven.
saturn.3: Talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to draw measured attention. You are read as speaking little and carefully, with duties toward a sibling, or a certain distance from those nearby.
saturn.4: Home, family and the parent tend to carry weight in your attention. You are read as carrying family duty, building slowly on land or property, and facing the end of things with seriousness.
saturn.5: Pleasure, romance, children and creative play tend to draw your attention with caution. You are read as taking enjoyment seriously, slow to relax, and committed in love and parenthood once settled.
saturn.6: Work and routine tend to draw steady attention. You are read as dependable at daily labour, thorough with detail, and inclined to watch your health with discipline and some worry.
saturn.7: Partners, marriage and contracts tend to hold your attention. You are read as taking commitments seriously, wary at first, and likely to meet open rivals who test your patience.
saturn.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what is owed tend to hold your attention. You are read as careful about obligations, and as facing loss and mortality with sobriety.
saturn.9: Long journeys, belief and higher learning tend to draw your attention. You are read as exacting about doctrine, slow to commit to a view, and serious about travel and study.
saturn.10: Career and public standing tend to draw sustained attention. You are read as building a reputation slowly through work and responsibility, and as bearing the weight of a visible position.
saturn.11: Friends, allies and hopes tend to draw your attention with caution. You are read as having few but lasting friends, patient in pursuing aims, and wary of groups until they prove themselves.
saturn.12: Your attention tends to land on solitude, retreat and what is carried privately. Saturn is traditionally at home here, so this reads as a capacity for being alone and for long, quiet work, with old fears to face.

uranus.1: Your attention tends to land on being different. You are read as someone whose manner or look is unusual, and whose way of presenting yourself can change suddenly.
uranus.2: Money and possessions tend to draw an unusual kind of attention. Income may come and go in surprising ways, and you are read as valuing independence over stability.
uranus.3: Talk, siblings and short trips tend to draw sudden, original thinking. You are read as an unconventional speaker, with unexpected turns in local ties.
uranus.4: Home and family tend to be touched by sudden change. You are read as someone whose roots are unconventional, who moves often, or who breaks from the family pattern.
uranus.5: Pleasure, romance and creative work tend to draw unconventional attention. You are read as drawn to the unusual in love and art, and to dealings with children that surprise you.
uranus.6: Work and routine tend to draw attention to change. You are read as restless in set tasks, inventive with methods, and prone to disrupt and rebuild your daily habits.
uranus.7: Partners tend to draw your attention in unusual ways. You are read as needing freedom within closeness, and as meeting people suddenly or parting from them abruptly.
uranus.8: Shared money, debts and inheritance tend to turn up surprises. You are read as drawn to the odd corners of what is owed, and to sudden changes in joint affairs.
uranus.9: Belief, travel and learning tend to draw original attention. You are read as questioning accepted views, drawn to foreign or unorthodox ideas, and prone to abrupt changes of mind.
uranus.10: Career and public standing tend to draw attention through change. You are read as visible for being unconventional, with a path that turns suddenly or breaks from the expected.
uranus.11: Friends and hopes tend to draw your attention, especially groups of unusual people. You are read as valuing friendship that leaves room for difference, with allies who appear or leave abruptly.
uranus.12: Hidden things tend to draw odd, sudden attention. You are read as having private flashes of insight, a need for solitude to think freshly, and a quiet streak of rebellion.

neptune.1: Your attention tends to land on a soft, shifting sense of self. You are read as impressionable, hard to pin down, and as seeming different to different people.
neptune.2: Money and possessions tend to draw a hazy attention. You are read as generous or unclear about what you have, and as needing to check figures others take for granted.
neptune.3: Talk and daily exchange tend to be coloured by imagination. You are read as speaking in images, picking up moods nearby, and sometimes misreading or being misread.
neptune.4: Home and family tend to hold a dreamlike weight. You are read as idealising or feeling uncertain about your roots, with a parent or house that is hard to define.
neptune.5: Pleasure, romance and creative work tend to draw idealised attention. You are read as imaginative in art and love, and as prone to falling for a picture of someone.
neptune.6: Work and routine tend to draw a vague, sensitive attention. You are read as responsive to the atmosphere of a workplace, and as needing clear habits to keep health and tasks steady.
neptune.7: Partners tend to draw idealising attention. You are read as seeking a bond that feels meant, and as needing to check contracts and what others say about themselves.
neptune.8: Shared money and what is owed tend to be unclear. You are read as sensitive to what is unspoken between people, and as needing plain records of debts and inheritance.
neptune.9: Belief, faraway places and learning tend to draw imaginative attention. You are read as drawn to the spiritual or the distant, and as inclined to trust a vision over proof.
neptune.10: Public standing tends to be blurred. You are read as having a reputation that is hard to fix, a career in imaginative or caring fields, and some uncertainty about direction.
neptune.11: Friends and hopes tend to carry an idealising colour. You are read as giving to groups and causes, and as sometimes misjudging whom to trust.
neptune.12: Hidden things tend to draw deep, quiet attention. You are read as sensitive to the unseen, with dreams, retreat and compassion, and with a need to protect yourself from escapism.

pluto.1: Your attention tends to land on intensity of presence. You are read as someone others sense strongly, who undergoes deep personal change, and who guards what lies underneath.
pluto.2: Money and possessions tend to draw intense attention. You are read as someone whose security is rebuilt more than once, and who thinks hard about power and what you truly hold.
pluto.3: Talk and daily exchange tend to carry weight. You are read as a penetrating speaker who notices what is concealed in conversation, with charged ties to siblings or neighbours.
pluto.4: Home and family tend to hold deep, buried material. You are read as someone whose roots involve upheaval or strong inheritance, and whose later years bring a clearing of old ground.
pluto.5: Pleasure, romance and creative work tend to be intense. You are read as passionate and all-or-nothing in love and art, with strong feelings around children.
pluto.6: Work and routine tend to draw thorough, almost obsessive attention. You are read as rebuilding systems at work, and as needing to watch compulsion and strain in your health.
pluto.7: Partners tend to draw strong attention. You are read as meeting powerful people in close bonds, with contracts and rivalries that change you.
pluto.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and death tend to draw deep attention, and Pluto fits this house's old themes closely. You are read as someone who looks straight at endings, power and what is owed.
pluto.9: Belief, travel and learning tend to draw intense attention. You are read as pursuing convictions to their roots, and as changed by encounters with foreign or ruling ideas.
pluto.10: Career and public standing tend to draw attention to power. You are read as someone whose public role involves authority, upheaval and renewal, and who may rise and fall more than once.
pluto.11: Friends, allies and hopes tend to involve power. You are read as drawn to influential groups, and as having friendships that change you or end hard.
pluto.12: Hidden things tend to draw the deepest attention. You are read as holding buried material, with long solitude and private reckonings that slowly change you.
